Workload_Assumptions.Target_Workload: Enterprise 5,000,000-Page Visually Rich Technical & Financial Document Search (ViDoRe / Multi-Table RAG Benchmark, 300 QPS)

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Standard Single-Vector Bi-Encoder (`1 × 1536d FP16` per Page) + Upstream OCR Pipeline
Configuration_Matrix.Indexing_And_Scoring: Compress Entire Page into 1 Dense Vector; Cosine Dot Product
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Plain-text homogeneous documents without complex visual tables, schematics, or dense part numbers

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Uncompressed Full Multi-Vector (`1,030 × 128d BF16` = `263.7 KB/Page` Stored in HNSW)
Configuration_Matrix.Indexing_And_Scoring: Store All 5.15 Billion Token/Patch Vectors in FP16 DRAM; Full `MaxSim` Scan
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Anti-pattern above 200K pages: 1,030 vectors per page causes a 49x RAM explosion ($22.8k/month)

Configuration_Matrix.Indexing_And_Scoring: K-Means Centroid ID + 2-Bit Residual Deltas (`~36 KB/Page`) + Centroid Pruning
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Dedicated text-only ColBERTv2 search indices with static centroid codebooks

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: 2-Stage Hybrid: Mean-Pooled Single-Vector Prefetch (`Top-200` in RAM) + `3x` Hierarchical Token-Pooled Binary `ColPali / ColBERT` `MaxSim` Rescore on NVMe Mmap
Configuration_Matrix.Indexing_And_Scoring: Stage 1: 128d Pooled Vector HNSW (`Top-200`) -> Stage 2: 340 Binary Patch Vectors/Page (`5.4 KB/Page`) Mmap `MaxSim`
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Production standard for ColPali/ColQwen2 & BGE-M3 multi-vector RAG (96.8% less RAM than raw ColPali, +22.2 pts Recall over Bi-Encoder)
